requirements.title: Local or use-associated generic nonelemental specifics are selected before elemental specifics
requirements.definition: For a name established as generic, a reference consistent with a nonelemental reference to one specific interface of a local or use-associated generic interface references the specific procedure that provides that interface.

pending.generic-nonelemental-specific-selected-f: Define generic g with a nonelemental vector function gv(x(:)) returning [201,202] and an elemental scalar function ge(x) returning x+100. Evaluate g([1,2]) into a vector initialized to [-1,-1] and expect [201,202], proving nonelemental preference over elemental mapping [101,102].

requirements.title: Elemental generic specifics are selected after nonelemental generic resolution fails
requirements.definition: Otherwise, a reference consistent with an elemental reference to one specific interface of a local or use-associated generic interface references that specific elemental procedure.

requirements.definition: Otherwise, a scoping unit INTRINSIC specification for the name, or USE association from a module where the name has the INTRINSIC attribute, resolves a reference consistent with that intrinsic interface to the intrinsic procedure.

requirements.title: Host generic names are resolved by applying generic rules in the host scoping unit
requirements.definition: Otherwise, a generic name established in a host scoping unit is resolved by applying the generic resolution rules to the host scoping unit, provided the inner and host scoping units agree on function versus subroutine status.

pending.host-generic-resolution-recurses-to-host: Host defines generic g with integer specific returning 1 and contained procedure has no local declaration; contained g(0) resolves by host generic rules and verifies 1. Companion contained procedure declares local integer external g returning 2 with the same reference spelling; g(0) verifies 2, proving local establishment prevents host-generic recursion.
pending.host-generic-function-subroutine-status-: Use a host generic function g and an inner function reference g(1), expecting 42. A source-control contrast attempts subroutine-style CALL g(1) and is not a diagnostic facet here.
